answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Reaching the sparrow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A tide of per-task receipts records who did what, and the raven of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
